user_question: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts. Active commitments: analytical_spatial_unit=census tracts

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the number of hospital point features within each Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital points from input_1 within the census tract polygons from input_2. Preserve the tract features and add a hospital-count attribute. Leave count_field and output_field unset so runtime QC can establish the output field name.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital-count choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce an interactive choropleth map showing hospital counts by census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an HTML choropleth from hospital_counts_by_tract. Map the runtime-grounded hospital-count field; do not assume or invent its column name.

requirements.scope: Hospital points and census tract polygons used by count_hospitals_by_tract must have compatible CRSs.
Hospital points and census tract polygons used by count_hospitals_by_tract must have valid, non-empty geometries.

The hospital_counts_by_tract artifact must contain a runtime-grounded attribute representing the hospital count for thematic mapping.

commitments.rationale: The request asks for counts across Centre County without specifying a spatial unit; census tracts are a defensible fine-grained unit and are directly available as an input boundary layer.
